plan.title: Rejected Bids Close Leaves RFQ Unchanged

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses tab with one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Keep counter offers available on RFQ rounds.
Allow bid rejection while bidding is open, matching the case configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Record the existing single direct vendor response before opening Rejected Bids.
Open the Rejected Bids window from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Confirm that the Rejected Bids window opened.
Confirm that the Rejected Bids window is closed.
Verify that the vendor response state remains unchanged after closing.
